environment.description: AWS Lambda function invoked via API Gateway (REST API) integrated through a Network Load Balancer with a VPC Link. The NLB has a target group pointing to VPC endpoint for execute-api. Upstream, a separate Application Load Balancer handles TLS termination and forwards to the NLB. The ALB has a security group (sg-0a4f8e2c1b) with inbound rules restricted to three CIDR blocks: 10.128.0.0/16 (internal service mesh), 172.20.0.0/14 (corporate VPN egress), and 192.168.100.0/24 (monitoring subnet). The ALB listener on port 443 has a fixed-response default action returning 403, with forward rules only matching host header 'token-service.internal.corp' AND source IP in the above ranges via condition-based routing. Additionally, the API Gateway has a resource policy that denies all requests not originating from the VPC endpoint (vpce-0f1a2b3c4d5e6f789). DNS for the service resolves only within the private hosted zone (internal.corp) associated with the VPC.

config.network_path: ALB -> NLB (VPC Link) -> API Gateway (private endpoint)
